title: 1991 Olivia De Berardinis Trading Card #5 Champagne Truffles
descriptionText: The product is a vintage 1992 trading card featuring Olivia De Berardinis' painting "Champagne Truffles" from the Olivia Series 1 set. This original, non-sport trading card by Comic Images is part of the base set and showcases the glamour genre. The card is in standard size and was manufactured in the United States, making it a collectible item for fans of Olivia De Berardinis' artwork.
